transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed and empty for a very long time now. It has been going on constantly for over two years, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy sadness.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyperactive, or 'on top of the world' with little need for sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have never had those kinds of high-energy or hyperactive phases where I felt on top of the world. It has really just been a constant low for me.
During these past two years, have you had any periods lasting more than two months where your mood returned to normal and you felt like your usual self?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This depressed mood has been completely continuous for the entire two years and four months. I haven't had a single period of normal mood lasting for two months or more during this whole time.
Along with this low mood, have you noticed other changes like issues with your sleep, appetite, energy levels, or how you feel about yourself?

My sleep and energy haven't really been the main issues, but my appetite has dropped significantly and I barely want to eat. More than anything, I just feel terrible about myself—I'm constantly criticizing my own flaws, feeling completely worthless and inferior to everyone else.
During these past two years, have you also experienced a complete loss of interest or pleasure in almost all activities you used to enjoy?
No, I wouldn't say I've experienced a complete loss of interest or pleasure in my activities. I can still find some enjoyment in things, even though my overall mood is constantly low.
Have you also found it difficult to concentrate, focus on tasks, or make decisions during this time?

Yes, I've been struggling significantly with both of those. I find it really hard to focus on simple things like watching TV or reading a book. Even small daily choices, like what to wear or what to eat, feel completely overwhelming and make me hesitate constantly.
Along with everything you've described, do you also experience feelings of hopelessness, like things will never get better for you?

I'm not really sure if I would call it hopelessness, and I don't particularly feel hopeless about the future. It's more that I just feel constantly sad, empty, and down on myself in my day-to-day life right now.

During these past two years, have you had any thoughts of death, felt that life isn't worth living, or had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of death, self-harm, or suicide. Even though I feel very low and worthless, those kinds of thoughts have not been a part of what I'm going through.
